subject: Orchestration playbook: VPC/on-prem demo — scheduling and intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request to schedule VPC/on-prem deep-dive demo

Mina / Karthik —

Quick intro: MediSys (Alice) asked for a technical deep-dive to validate VPC networking, on-prem connectivity options, and IAM integration before they sign the SOW. Alice is the lead cloud engineer and wants SE-level detail (routing, egress, peering, certs).

Can we propose 90 minutes for the session and include procurement/security briefly at the end for any contract/controls questions? I suggested these agenda items:
- 20m: architecture overview (Redwood runtime + private control plane)
- 30m: VPC peering / on-prem connectivity patterns (VPN, direct connect, firewalls)
- 20m: IAM / key management, audit logs, data boundaries
- 20m: Q&A + procurement/security checklist

Alice is in PDT and asked for the week of Aug 24 if possible. Mina — would you own scheduling and attendee list? Karthik — can you lead the VPC/network slides?

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf]

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsyscorp.com, Samir Shah <samir.shah@healthapps.io>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule VPC/on-prem deep-dive demo

Thanks Ben — that agenda looks good. A few constraints from our side:
1) Our network team is only available mornings PT that week (8:30–11:30am).
2) We need SOC 2 / security posture summary ahead of the session for our Security intake. Can you share a brief doc or pointer?
3) Procurement wants a short mutual action plan so they know what approvals are required after the demo.

If you can send 2–3 morning options for Aug 24–26 and the SOC 2 one-pager, I’ll loop in our infra folks.

—Alice
Alice Nguyen | Lead Cloud Engineer, MediSys Health
alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com | +1 206-555-0147

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@healthapps.io>, procurement@medsyscorp.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule VPC/on-prem deep-dive demo

Hi Alice — thanks for the constraints. Proposed time slots (all PT):
- Tue Aug 24, 9:00–10:30am PT
- Wed Aug 25, 8:30–10:00am PT
- Thu Aug 26, 10:00–11:30am PT (we know this is later in the morning; included for SE availability)

Karthik will run the VPC/network section. I’ll cover the private control plane and audit logs, and Ben will handle customer success/next steps.

Attached is a short SOC 2 summary and the demo agenda. I’m also attaching a one-page mutual action plan template — we can tailor it after the demo.

Please confirm the preferred slot and we’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and pre-reads.

Mina
Mina Haddad | Sales Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0133
[Attachments: soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

From: procurement@medsyscorp.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@healthapps.io>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule VPC/on-prem deep-dive demo

Thanks for the materials. A couple of procurement asks before confirming:
- Please confirm data residency options and whether audit logs can be forwarded to our SIEM (we use Splunk).
- Need a draft SOW timeline and who the contracting party will be (Redwood Inference US entity).
- If we move forward, procurement will require a POC Milestone and an initial 3-month reserved slot — can you outline how Dedicated vs Private would be handled operationally?

If you can include brief notes on those three items in the calendar invite or mutual action plan, that will speed approval on our side.

Procurement Team
MediSys Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medsyscorp.com>, procurement@medsyscorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@healthapps.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule VPC/on-prem deep-dive demo — confirmed (Wed 8/25 8:30am PT)

Confirmed: Wed, Aug 25 — 8:30–10:00am PT (90m). Calendar invite sent to all.

Quick notes added to the MAP and invite:
- Data residency: Hosted + Dedicated options support region pinning; Private can be deployed on-prem (customer-managed network).
- Audit logs: Redwood supports streaming audit logs to external SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog) via secure forwarding; will include config examples in the pre-reads.
- Contracting / SOW: Redwood Inference, Inc. will be the contracting party. Draft SOW timeline (POC -> Pilot -> Production) included in the MAP (see HubSpot link).

Karthik / Ben — please be prepared to show network flow diagrams and a short phase plan for trialing Dedicated capacity (30m technical + 15m procurement Q&A).

See drive link for pre-reads.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.
Mina
--
Mina Haddad | Sales Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
[Calendar invite: Redwood — MediSys technical deep-dive.ics]
[Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]
